plate.narration: A sheltered ledge looks out across the glacier. On an upturned sledge, a broad map waits beside loose sheets and a warm lantern. Beyond the shelter, the ice stretches blue and quiet.

goal.text: Compare your discoveries and help the travelers steady a new opening.

voiceGuide.tone: Warm, curious and practical. Short sentences. Show the consequence of each plan. Nobody dies.

npcVoices.Orin Vale: Methodical griffin scholar. Asks what a test actually showed.
npcVoices.Lady Olivia: Ambitious unicorn. Certain at first, surprised by limits, never punished for disagreeing.
npcVoices.Bram Lock: Protective bigfoot. Short practical requests, never orders the party.
npcVoices.Seren Wisp: Patient kitsune specialist. Distinguishes holding a condition from changing a rule.
npcVoices.Pip Thistledown: Eager manticore scout. His choice mirrors the party.

arrival.narration: At a sheltered glacier ledge, Orin waves you over to a map on an upturned sled. Olivia greets you and steadies one corner. Your Riftseeker friends have made room for your account. A bigfoot named Bram Lock keeps the path clear. "Help me keep everyone behind the line when an opening comes," he asks. Orin weights the map with his boot. "Compare your discoveries. Then help us steady any opening before people go near it." His boot is still on his foot.

accounts.narration: Orin makes room for your accounts. "Only the ones you actually brought." Seren Wisp, the kitsune teacher, brings her chime; Pip catches a page with his tail and pretends he meant to. Choose a comparison your road supports, or ask Orin to guide your two checked pages. Nothing here requires taking a memory or a stone.

choices.label: Let Orin guide our two checked accounts
Compare the memory-ice account and bridge drawing
Compare the memory-ice account and island record
Compare the bridge drawing and island record

accounts_guided.narration: Hold the first checked page flat while Orin places the other beside it. Name which edges you actually saw and leave the missing stretches blank. This is a guided comparison, not an independent new reading.

interaction.cue: Hold the two checked pages apart for Orin.

onSuccess.narration: Orin labels the guided comparison without inventing a third account.

onFailure.narration: Orin labels the guided comparison without inventing a third account.

onAssisted.narration: Orin labels the guided comparison without inventing a third account.

compare_paths_coast.narration: Follow the marked river-copy as Orin slides the covered paper layers. The copy came from the memory readers; your bridge drawing shows a different present place. These are drawings on the sled, not objects moved out of those places.

interaction.cue: Follow the marked river-copy through the paper layers.

onSuccess.narration: You identify the marked copy and keep the two sources separate.

onFailure.narration: Orin uncovers the marked copy and labels the comparison as helped.

onAssisted.narration: Orin uncovers the marked copy and labels the comparison as helped.

compare_paths_sky.narration: Orin points to a river curve, a copied boundary notch and the blank between them. Watch his four pointing marks, then echo them without drawing a joining line. Your island record and the memory readers' account remain separate sources.

interaction.cue: Watch the pointing marks, then echo them.

onSuccess.narration: You distinguish the copied marks from the unobserved gap.

onFailure.narration: Orin repeats the pointing round and labels the comparison as helped.

onAssisted.narration: Orin repeats the pointing round and labels the comparison as helped.

compare_coast_sky.narration: Move the bridge-copy edge beside the copied island carving while Orin holds their scales steady. Stop at the checked marks; the gap between them stays unclaimed.

onSuccess.narration: The two checked edges can be compared without stretching their scales.

onFailure.narration: The scale slipped. Orin restores the broad comparison and marks the fine alignment as unchecked.

onAssisted.narration: The scale slipped. Orin restores the broad comparison and marks the fine alignment as unchecked.

measure.narration: Two accounts are ready. Loose sheets can be weighted with stones, leaving the felt-wrapped prop free for your holding lesson later. A string measure uses that prop to pin its end; you must retrieve it before using it in the lesson. Which setup will you play?

choices.label: Level the separate pages under smooth weights
Guide the string measure onto its reference mark

measure_sheets.narration: Level the loose sheets under smooth weights. Orin moves his boot off the paper first. He is learning.

onSuccess.narration: The checked outlines are ready. The felt-wrapped prop stays free.

onFailure.narration: The checked outlines are ready. The felt-wrapped prop stays free.

onAssisted.narration: The checked outlines are ready. The felt-wrapped prop stays free.

measure_line.narration: Guide the string to the reference mark while the felt-wrapped prop pins its far end. Nobody ties it around a traveler.

interaction.cue: Guide the string to its reference mark.

onSuccess.narration: The string records the checked span; its prop stays in use.

onFailure.narration: Bram checks the broad span after the slip. Fine distances stay unclaimed; the prop still pins the string.

onAssisted.narration: Bram checks the broad span after the slip. Fine distances stay unclaimed; the prop still pins the string.

evidence.narration: Orin labels the places your party actually visited. Checked observations and the help you received stay on the page together. Orin grins. "A very confident guess still gets a question mark."

variants.text: The memory readers showed you an old arrangement in the ice. Their memory stays with them; your account can be compared here.
At the buried bridge, you checked an old river crossing against the coast around it. Your drawing carries the shape, without taking any stone.
The island mooring stone showed an old boundary unlike the ground below it today. The stone stays with its keepers.

pull.narration: Snow grains slide toward the deep passage. "Could you steady my board while your friend marks the grains?" Bram asks. Your Listening Chime tests readiness and an open way back; it cannot tell an opening where to go. Pip moves his tail out of the experiment.

interaction.cue: Hold the measuring board while a friend marks the pull.

onSuccess.narration: The sheltered grains mark a pull toward the deep passage.

onFailure.narration: The sheltered grains mark a pull toward the deep passage.

onAssisted.narration: The sheltered grains mark a pull toward the deep passage.

clear_path.narration: You and Bram move the loose benches behind the working line. He checks the passage with his shoulders. There is room to turn back together. Orin rescues his notebook from beneath a bench leg. "An excellent support. A poor library."

signals.narration: Seren shows wait, shelter, wait. Watch the signals and echo them before the experiment. Pip checks that his wings do not hide the hand from the back row.

interaction.cue: Watch the safe-lane signals, then echo them.

onSuccess.narration: Your party can lead the checked signal round.

onFailure.narration: Bram will lead visible signals from the clear lane. Your record names that help.

onAssisted.narration: Bram will lead visible signals from the clear lane. Your record names that help.

rest.narration: Orin rolls the map away from the sled seat and opens the camp supper bag. You share dried apple rings and warm water from the camp flask. Pip tries to weigh a page with an apple ring, then eats the paperweight.

proposal.narration: "Let me call one small opening near the pull," says Olivia. Orin asks for more observations; Bram keeps the retreat clear. Give one condition the people must meet before anyone approaches. Olivia still believes she can choose what she calls.

choices.label: Keep someone watching the way back

summoning.narration: Olivia lifts her working hand. An opening unfolds above the empty snow: wind, moving grit, a light she studies twice. She gestures again. It stops widening, but does nothing else she asked. The chime sounds sour. Bram reaches toward her hand. "Enough. Step back." Pip starts toward Olivia, then looks at you. The opening is real. So is the choice about what happens next.

decision.narration: Bram turns to you. "Help me stop the experiment." Olivia shakes her head. "Stay beside me. I will stop feeding it and watch what it does." What will you do?

choices.label: Help Bram bring Olivia behind the boundary
Stay with Olivia while she stops and observes
Ask Orin to talk her back with your readings

bram_plan.narration: You stand with Bram across the lane, leaving Olivia room to step away. "Look at us, not the opening," he says. Pip stops behind the boundary when he sees your choice. Olivia lowers her hand instead of reaching through.

olivia_plan.narration: You stay on the marked working ground beside Olivia. She stops the summoning gesture, and you hold the retreat lane clear. Pip follows you, keeping his paws behind the mark. "We watch," Olivia says. "We do not cross." Bram stays ready at the shelter.

orin_plan.narration: Orin repeats the chime readings your party shared beside the buried bridge. "We learned something by waiting," he says. "Let this one answer first." Olivia lowers her hand and walks behind the boundary. Pip stays back with you. Bram lets out the breath he was holding.

bram_clear.narration: Pass the loose gear behind Bram's line while he brings Olivia back. Your party follows the choice you made; nobody grabs her or corners her against the opening.

interaction.cue: Pass the loose gear behind the boundary.

onSuccess.narration: Everyone and the gear are clear of the pull.

onFailure.narration: Everyone and the gear are clear of the pull.

onAssisted.narration: Everyone and the gear are clear of the pull.

variants.text: Your checked retreat signals help Bram guide the party.
Bram leads the visible retreat signals; the account credits his help.

olivia_watch.narration: Olivia stops feeding the opening. Mark its next clear view from the working ground without crossing. Pip stays with your party; Bram holds the retreat lane.

interaction.cue: Observe the stopped opening during its clear interval.

onSuccess.narration: You record what remained after the gesture stopped.

onFailure.narration: The view narrowed before your mark. Leave it unclaimed and secure the gear; do not move closer.

onAssisted.narration: The view narrowed before your mark. Leave it unclaimed and secure the gear; do not move closer.

steady_check.narration: Support the loose screen while Bram pins its edge from the safe lane. Olivia and Pip draw back with you before anyone compares the chime.

interaction.cue: Support the wind-caught screen from the safe lane.

onSuccess.narration: The people and gear are behind the safe line.

onFailure.narration: The people and gear are behind the safe line.

onAssisted.narration: The people and gear are behind the safe line.

orin_account.narration: Orin has the chime account you shared beside the buried bridge. Choose which checked limit helps him talk Olivia back. The opening is not required to obey anybody's request.

choices.label: Waiting gave us a clearer reading
An echo checked an open way back
A clear note never chose a destination

count.narration: A screen cord flaps and the chime note wavers. Seren holds that ordinary cord still; the note changes. She lets it move and the note changes back. "The cord," she says. "We will change that, and listen to the separate chime." Nobody crosses the experimental opening.

count_check.narration: Hold the screen cord still while a friend notes the chime's answer. The control moves the cord, not the chime. Solo heroes can support it on Seren's fixed hook.

interaction.cue: Hold the screen cord while a friend records the chime note.

onSuccess.narration: The held-cord answer is recorded. Now compare the released cord.

onFailure.narration: The held-cord answer is recorded. Now compare the released cord.

onAssisted.narration: The held-cord answer is recorded. Now compare the released cord.

cord_release.narration: Release the cord from behind the line and compare the note during the clear listening interval. The opening's destination does not change.

interaction.cue: Release the screen cord and compare the note.

onSuccess.narration: The note wavers again with the cord loose. Seren nods. "Holding it changed a condition, not an opening's rule."

onFailure.narration: A gust hid the comparison. Shelter the listening position while Seren demonstrates the released cord.

onAssisted.narration: A gust hid the comparison. Shelter the listening position while Seren demonstrates the released cord.

cord_help.narration: Pass the loose wind cover to Bram at the sheltered listening position. Seren releases the cord and lets everyone hear the checked comparison. Your record credits her demonstration.

interaction.cue: Pass wind cover to the listening position.

onSuccess.narration: You have a checked, helped comparison without repeating the gust-spoiled test.

onFailure.narration: You have a checked, helped comparison without repeating the gust-spoiled test.

onAssisted.narration: You have a checked, helped comparison without repeating the gust-spoiled test.

lesson.narration: Seren calls the lesson Manipulate. "Hold a condition that is already there. Do not change a one-way rule or grant a second use." Practice by handing the padded grip from helper to helper, or by balancing the felt prop at the cord's mark. A prop still pinning your string measure must first be brought back.

choices.label: Pass the holding grip through the team
Retrieve the prop from our string measure
Practice with our starweaver and Seren

lesson_team.narration: Pass the padded holding grip while the next helper takes the marked position. Seren watches the cord; the paper record already preserves the string measurement. Nobody calls a new opening into being.

interaction.cue: Pass the holding grip without losing the marked position.

onSuccess.narration: Every helper has practiced the shared holding job.

onFailure.narration: Every helper has practiced the shared holding job.

onAssisted.narration: Every helper has practiced the shared holding job.

retrieve_prop.narration: Pass the felt prop back from the string board. Orin keeps your checked measurement on paper; the measuring string can now be packed.

interaction.cue: Pass the used measuring prop back for the lesson.

onSuccess.narration: The prop is free after the extra handling job.

onFailure.narration: The prop is free after the extra handling job.

onAssisted.narration: The prop is free after the extra handling job.

lesson_prop.narration: Balance the felt-wrapped prop at the cord's marked point. Seren checks the note while the party watches for slack. The tiny knitted cover keeps the prop from scratching the screen.

interaction.cue: Level the padded prop at the marked cord.

onSuccess.narration: The prop holds the observed condition for the group.

onFailure.narration: The prop holds the observed condition for the group.

onAssisted.narration: The prop holds the observed condition for the group.

lesson_attuned.narration: Your starweaver holds the observed condition with Seren while the party checks the cord and note. This replaces the separate grip-passing or prop-setting job. It does not change the destination or permit a crossing.

lesson_clear.narration: You have practiced Manipulate: hold a condition long enough for the group while the opening keeps its own rules. Seren releases the cord only after everyone is behind the mark. The sour note returns; the ordinary walking passage stays your route.

account.narration: Make the experiment useful to the next watcher. Choose one checked result to add; guesses stay questions. Olivia adds her own sentence: "I called an opening, but I did not choose its rules."

choices.label: Draw the held and released cord

ending.narration: The travelers have heard the party's discoveries, the experiment is safely stopped, and you have learned to hold a condition without changing a rule. The pull points down the deep passage. Your party is ready to follow the ordinary walking route and find out.

variants.text: Olivia remembers that you backed her at the whales and told her no here. "I will compare the notes with Orin," she says. Pip stays beside the safe mark.
Olivia remembers your help at the whales. "I can hold a condition too," she says. "If the ground starts moving, I will help hold it." Pip walks with her, watching the marked lane.
Olivia closes her notebook and chooses her own work. "I still think we can do more," she says. She leaves by the open walking path, free to disagree.
Your party recorded the held-and-released cord comparison.
The cord comparison is credited to Seren's checked demonstration.
Your glimpse after the summoning stopped remains unclaimed; nobody fills it in from a guess.

finish.narration: Seren checks the shelter once more. The experimental opening stays marked for watchers. You carry the map down the walking passage toward the heart of the glacier.

proposal_response_wait.narration: Bram moves the last loose gear back. The people have a boundary and a way back.

proposal_response_stop.narration: Olivia agrees to stop before anyone crosses. The people have a boundary and a way back.

proposal_response_watch.narration: Seren takes a clear view of the retreat lane. The people have a boundary and a way back.

orin_account_response_wait.narration: Orin asks Olivia to let this opening answer first. Olivia agrees to step behind the line with you.

orin_account_response_back.narration: Orin points to the walking route you already have. Olivia agrees to step behind the line with you.

orin_account_response_rules.narration: Olivia lowers her hand and listens. Olivia agrees to step behind the line with you.

account_response_cord.narration: Seren labels the changed condition. Your account names what changed and what did not.

account_response_lane.narration: Bram thickens the safe boundary line. Your account names what changed and what did not.

account_response_limit.narration: Orin puts a question beside the blank, then another beside Pip's confident doodle. Your account names what changed and what did not.
